messages:
Priya S: incoming support escalation from tenant-acct-42 — decrypt errors started 2026-03-10 19:12 UTC. They see 403s from our proxy and ~200k retries causing billing spike.
Maya R: can you paste the error snippet they see? 403 usually means encryption context mismatch or missing grant.
Priya S: 
> "Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: EncryptionContext missing or invalid"
Also saw rows in app logs: "kms_proxy: decrypt error code=AccessDenied context={tenant:42, job:presign}"
Liam K: did we rotate any key aliases or remove grants around that time? I don't see scheduled rotation in our tracker.
Jonah P: no planned rotation. But I pulled CloudTrail for the CMK ARN and there are gaps in PutGrant/RetireGrant events between 19:05–19:20 UTC for the region. suspicious.
KMS-bot: CloudTrail sampling detected: some management events not recorded due to high load — recommends checking S3 delivery and EventSelectors.
Maya R: if grants got retired (or sessions expired) the proxy should fallback to tenant-specific fallback key, but the logs show immediate 403s not fallback events. Suggest repro steps.
Priya S: repro steps from customer: they call our REST /decrypt endpoint with X-Enc-Ctx header (base64), and our proxy calls KMS with EncryptionContext={tenant:42,requestor:svc}. They see AccessDenied immediately.
Liam K: can we confirm encryption context headers are intact through the proxy? I recall a prior bug where long headers were truncated by the nginx proxy (>8k). This tenant's context keys grew large after a recent metadata change.
Jonah P: looking at nginx config — client_header_buffer_size 1k, large_client_header_buffers 4 8k. If the base64 encctx > 8k it will get truncated. We had a deploy that changed metadata keys last week.
Maya R: good lead. If encctx truncation changed the computed encryption context, KMS will reject. But that wouldn't explain missing CloudTrail events. Two parallel issues?
Liam K: maybe truncated header caused repeated retries which overwhelmed CloudTrail delivery and S3 put events were dropped temporarily (we saw gaps). That could explain billing spike and missing audit entries.
Priya S: action items and ask for customer:
- Can customer send the full X-Enc-Ctx header value (base64) for a failing request? ideally from their client logs.
- Meanwhile we'll enable a proxy request log to capture raw header length and sha256, and increase nginx large_client_header_buffers to 16k.
Maya R: also rotate the grant flow: issue a short-lived grant for the proxy role and add a fallback path that logs when grant is absent and uses service-account key (with audit tag). Create a canary to avoid immediate retries.
Jonah P: I'll push the nginx buffer change to staging and add header-log middleware. Here's the quick debug config:

```
# nginx conf snippet
large_client_header_buffers 8 16k;
log_format hdrlen '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" ' 
  'encctx_len=$http_x_enc_ctx_length encctx_hash=$upstream_http_x_enc_ctx_hash';
access_log /var/log/nginx/encctx.log hdrlen;
```

Liam K: commands I ran to inspect CMK grants:

```
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef --region us-west-2
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --start-time 2026-03-10T19:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-10T19:30:00Z
```

Priya S: noted. I'll ask customer for header and share the snippet. Also opening ticket INC-2026-8421 and CCing tenant-secu contact. Priya -> assign to Jonah for nginx change and to Maya for grant audit.
Maya R: I'll audit grants and key policy for tenant-acct-42, check for any service principal removals or revoked grants. If we find grant retirements, we'll coordinate immediate grant reissue and a postmortem for CloudTrail gaps.
Jonah P: will deploy staging fix in 30m, will deploy to prod after smoke tests. I'll collect encctx.log tail and paste here when available.
KMS-bot: scheduled action — create short-lived grant: /kms/create-grant request queued (agent: Maya R)
Priya S: thanks all. I'll update tenant and ask them to pause retries for now (we can queue and backoff). :thumbsup:
